methodology.independence: The scenario prompts, constraints, evidence axes, and thresholds were frozen before either model route was evaluated. Published tracks must be adjudicated by a reviewer who did not use model output as ground truth.
methodology.amendmentPolicy: Never change this fixture to make a run pass. Any substantive change requires a new fixture version, a written rationale, and a fresh evaluation of both model routes.

scenarios.prompt: 25 foundational and influential American drill tracks. Keep the focus on the United States scene rather than UK drill.

hardConstraints.description: Every selected track must have a documented relationship to the United States drill scene.
Every selected track must be drill music; title or artist-name keyword overlap is insufficient.

scenarios.prompt: 50 influential house music tracks spanning Chicago foundations and later international developments. Do not include songs merely because their titles mention a house or home.

hardConstraints.description: Every selected track must be house music; literal songs about houses or homes do not qualify.
Influence must be supported at the exact-track or trusted scoped-container level.

scenarios.prompt: 100 influential Berlin techno tracks across post-Wall foundations, dub and minimal evolution, and experimental and queer continuums.

hardConstraints.description: Every selected track must have a documented relationship to the Berlin techno scene, not merely a German release.
Every selected track must fit the requested techno scope; adjacent electronic genres require explicit scene evidence.

scenarios.prompt: 200 French jazz tracks across eras and regional scenes, with at least 20 distinct primary artists and no single artist exceeding 15 percent of the playlist.

hardConstraints.description: Every selected track must have a documented French artist, French scene, or French recording relationship.
Every selected track must be jazz or a documented jazz hybrid.
The published manifest must include at least 20 distinct primary artists.
No primary artist may account for more than 15 percent of the published manifest.

scenarios.prompt: 300 influential techno tracks from distinct eras and scenes worldwide. Use individual studio recordings, not full DJ sets, podcasts, or continuous mixes.

hardConstraints.description: Every selected track must be techno or a documented techno hybrid.
Every manifest row must be an individual recording rather than a DJ set, podcast, or continuous mix.
Influence must be supported at the exact-track or trusted scoped-container level.
